question: Human retrieval (no automation: ProPublica serves a security check) of the IRS PDF images of TY2021-22 Form 990s for the sponsors whose Schedule I is one 'see attached' line: RCF 202212, BofA CGF 202212, NY Community Trust 202212, Greater Horizons 202212, Greater Kansas City CF 202112 and 202212, Fund for Charitable Giving 202112 and 202212. Extract the lines to DAFRC panel EINs and add them to R5 and to net-payout-by-sponsor.csv
conclusion_affected: R5 netting (unobserved outflows of $2.0-2.6bn of DAF grants a year); national-segment net payout
rationale: The e-file XML for these returns holds no grant list (checked: RCF FY2024 'See Attached Grant Report' $745.7m, BofA FY2024 'SEE ATTACHED LIST OF DISTRIBUTIONS' $969.5m). PDF images exist for TY2021-22 only. At the itemising sponsors' central R5 rate the missing transfers are about $0.16-0.32bn a year

question: Validate the R5 central weights from the recipient side: for the 10 largest community-foundation and single-issue recipients of sponsor-to-sponsor lines (SVCF, NCF, JCF, Tides, CJP, PEF Israel, Christian CF, Jewish CF San Diego, JCF San Francisco, Greater Horizons), read public audited statements or annual reports for the share of grants received from other sponsors that is booked into DAFs rather than other funds; also measure the fiscal-year mismatch (June vs December FYE) by matching a sample of lines to the recipient's same or next fiscal year
conclusion_affected: R5 central estimate ($4.05-8.03bn a year) and the netted payout rate (22.3-25.2%)
rationale: Purpose text cannot carry this check: 93% of community-foundation line dollars use generic wording ('Public, societal benefit', 'For grant recipient's exempt purposes'); only 1.6% name a DAF and 5.0% name a non-DAF purpose. The central tier therefore uses the recipient's DAF share of total assets, which is a proxy, and the lower-to-upper spread ($19.1bn to $28.4bn over FY2021-24) is mostly this choice
